title: Father and Son Halloween Pumpkin Racer with Minecraft Toys and Scooby Doo Sister
description:
We built a Halloween Pumpkin race car!!  Watch as we race our pumpkin racer down a slide and over Minecraft bad guys!  Evan built the racer from one medium pumpkin, 2 threaded rods, 4 lawn mower wheels, hex nuts, washers and acorn nuts.  Evan picks Steve from minecraft to drive it.  Steve has to go against skeletons, creepers, zombies, drowns, pigmen and Enderman.  The Incredible Hulk joins in on the fun driving Barbies pink Jeep.  Watch as they crash, smash and bash each other.
